title: Glowing crystal ball
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- stand base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='22' ry='7' fill='#8B6914'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='20' ry='6' fill='#C4A035'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='79' rx='16' ry='4.5' fill='#E8C84A'/>
  <!-- stand neck -->
  <path d='M40 78 Q40 70 44 68 L56 68 Q60 70 60 78 Z' fill='#B8961E'/>
  <path d='M42 77 Q42 71 45 69 L55 69 Q58 71 58 77 Z' fill='#D4B030'/>
  <!-- crystal ball outer glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='30' fill='#2A1A5E' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='27' fill='#4A2A9E' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- crystal ball main body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='24' fill='#6B4FCC'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='22' fill='#8B6FE8'/>
  <!-- inner glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='17' fill='#B49AFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='12' fill='#D9CCFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='8' fill='#F0EAFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- glow rays -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#C4AAFF' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#E0D4FF' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- sparkle star -->
  <path d='M50 38 L51.5 44 L58 45.5 L51.5 47 L50 53 L48.5 47 L42 45.5 L48.5 44 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- small sparkles -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#FFE87C'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#FFE87C'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#FFE87C'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#FFE87C'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='50' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='52' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
